findings.explanation: ResourceQuota objects most often use requests.cpu, limits.cpu, requests.memory, limits.memory and requests.storage, and extended resources may only be quota'd as requests.<name> (e.g. requests.nvidia.com/gpu). The list presents bare cpu/memory as the norm, and the SPL allow-list mirrors it, silently ignoring the common keys.
findings.quote: kube_resourcequota with type hard and type used labels for cpu, memory, pods, services, configmaps, persistentvolumeclaims, services.nodeports, services.loadbalancers, and extended resources such as nvidia.com/gpu
findings.suggested_fix: List the actual quota resource names (requests.*/limits.* compute, requests.storage, count/<resource>, requests.nvidia.com/gpu) and describe the allow-list accordingly.

findings.explanation: The SPL does no regression. streamstats takes first() and last() of util_ratio in a 28-point window and divides their difference by the elapsed time, so the forecast is a two-point slope that a single noisy endpoint can distort.
findings.quote: linear regression across six-hour buckets assumes roughly monotonic growth
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the method as an endpoint slope over the window, or point to a real least-squares approach (e.g. streamstats sums or predict/trendline) if regression is intended.

findings.explanation: kube-state-metrics has no separate extended-resource collector. The resourcequotas collector emits every resource present in the ResourceQuota spec and status, including extended ones.
findings.quote: Enable extended-resource collectors when device plugins register nvidia.com/gpu, amd.com/gpu, or internal vendor.com segments
findings.suggested_fix: Say that the quota must define requests.<extended-resource> for it to appear in kube_resourcequota; no extra collector is needed.

findings.explanation: The data arrives through the OTel Collector prometheus receiver and HEC, as the same field and the guide state. The Universal Forwarder modular-input sentence (repeated as the app suffix) contradicts that and is template residue.
findings.quote: Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the sentence and the '— Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)' suffix in app.

findings.explanation: ResourceQuota gauges map to neither model. Application_State has been deprecated since CIM 4.12.0 and describes host process and service inventory, and Performance host CPU/memory is not namespace quota consumption. The SPL's Application_State join adds nothing to the forecast.
findings.suggested_fix: Leave cimModels empty and drop the CIM alignment paragraph and plat_state narrative, or justify a model with fields the detection uses.

findings.explanation: No SNMP or UPS data is involved in ResourceQuota forecasting; the snmp equipment tag and snmp_ups model are residue.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove snmp_ups and the snmp equipment entry.

findings.explanation: No hrs_to_72 field exists. The SPL produces hrs_to_full and the forecast_hit_72h severity.
findings.quote: measure whether hrs_to_72 would have fired the morning before denial

findings.explanation: The UC is marked verified under a generic reviewer handle, yet the search fails to parse and the lab test in Step 4 could not have been executed against it.
findings.suggested_fix: Downgrade status until the SPL runs end to end in a lab cluster, and record the SME reviewer.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Both multisearch arms end with stats ... BY ... _time, but multisearch allows only streaming commands in its subsearches, so the search is rejected.

The resource allow-list ^(cpu|memory|pods|services|configmaps|persistentvolumeclaims)$ plus nodeports/loadbalancers drops requests.cpu, limits.cpu, requests.memory, limits.memory and requests.storage, which are the most common quota keys, so most CPU and memory quotas are never forecast.

The severity filter runs before 'sort 0 - _time | dedup', so dedup can keep an older alerting bin when the latest bin is healthy, producing stale alerts. Separately, util_ratio<=1.02 discards over-quota rows that the saturated_now tier is meant to catch.

It uses Application_State.state, Application_State.info and Application_State.app with nodename=Application_State. The deprecated model's root is All_Application_State and defines no such fields, and none of it relates to ResourceQuota.

summary: This is a well-scoped quota-forecast UC with clear sibling boundaries and a good lab plan. But the SPL cannot run, because multisearch arms contain stats. Its resource allow-list drops the most common quota keys (requests.cpu, limits.memory and similar). The prose calls the forecast a linear regression when the SPL computes a two-point slope, and the CIM and equipment mappings are unrelated template residue.
